title: Exactness on the degree-zero homogeneous localized piece
statement: For a single graded exact triple satisfying the hypotheses of lem-sc-graded-localization-exact, the induced localized maps are exact on the degree-zero homogeneous pieces.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 09MR proof, Mayer–Vietoris paragraph (localization exactness)

proof.text: Apply IsLocalizedModule.map_exact to the powers of s. For y in the degree-zero homogeneous piece with localized g-map zero, obtain a localized preimage z under the localized f-map. Represent z by finitely many homogeneous components using the internal direct-sum decomposition of M₀. The degree-preservation hypothesis for f sends the component of degree e to degree e, so the degree-zero component z₀ maps to the degree-zero component of y; since y itself has degree zero, all nonzero-degree components of f(z) vanish and f(z₀)=y. The definition of homogeneousPieceAway shows z₀ lies in the degree-zero piece. Conversely, exactness of f and g gives gₛ(fₛ(z₀))=0.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Tag 09MR, Mayer–Vietoris paragraph

proof.text: The same component argument applies when d = 0 and when the localization is subsingleton (for example s = 0); zero belongs to every required homogeneous subgroup, so these edge cases introduce no extra hypothesis.

theorem graded_localization_degree_zero_exact {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (𝓐 : ℤ → AddSubgroup A) (_h𝓐 : DirectSum.IsInternal 𝓐)
    (_hmul : ∀ (a b : ℤ) (r t : A), r ∈ 𝓐 a → t ∈ 𝓐 b → r * t ∈ 𝓐 (a + b))
    (s : A) (d : ℤ) (_hd : 0 ≤ d) (_hs : s ∈ 𝓐 d)
    {M₀ M₁ M₂ : Type*} [AddCommGroup M₀] [AddCommGroup M₁] [AddCommGroup M₂]
    [Module A M₀] [Module A M₁] [Module A M₂]
    (𝓜₀ : ℤ → AddSubgroup M₀) (𝓜₁ : ℤ → AddSubgroup M₁)
    (𝓜₂ : ℤ → AddSubgroup M₂)
    (_h𝓜₀ : DirectSum.IsInternal 𝓜₀) (_h𝓜₁ : DirectSum.IsInternal 𝓜₁)
    (_h𝓜₂ : DirectSum.IsInternal 𝓜₂)
    (_hsmul₀ : ∀ (a b : ℤ) (r : A) (m : M₀), r ∈ 𝓐 a → m ∈ 𝓜₀ b → r • m ∈ 𝓜₀ (a + b))
    (_hsmul₁ : ∀ (a b : ℤ) (r : A) (m : M₁), r ∈ 𝓐 a → m ∈ 𝓜₁ b → r • m ∈ 𝓜₁ (a + b))
    (_hsmul₂ : ∀ (a b : ℤ) (r : A) (m : M₂), r ∈ 𝓐 a → m ∈ 𝓜₂ b → r • m ∈ 𝓜₂ (a + b))
    (f : M₀ →ₗ[A] M₁) (g : M₁ →ₗ[A] M₂)
    (hf : ∀ n x, x ∈ 𝓜₀ n → f x ∈ 𝓜₁ n)
    (hg : ∀ n x, x ∈ 𝓜₁ n → g x ∈ 𝓜₂ n)
    (hex : Function.Exact f g) :
    ∀ y ∈ homogeneousPieceAway 𝓜₁ s d 0,
      (IsLocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers s) (mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers s) M₁)
        (mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers s) M₂) g) y = 0 ↔
      ∃ x ∈ homogeneousPieceAway 𝓜₀ s d 0,
        (IsLocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers s) (mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers s) M₀)
          (mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers s) M₁) f) x = y
